Good questions.

Can we order mixed sizes?

Include your size breakdown in the team brief. Confirm available sizes and minimum quantities with the store.

Does creating a brief place an order?

No. The Team Orders form creates a downloadable brief. Nothing is sent, ordered or paid for online.
